criteria.name: Sim routes render at least one KaTeX formula
criteria.evidence: src/app/simView.ts:28-46 defines FORMULAS_BY_SLUG with keys gray-scott, mandelbrot, julia-set, burning-ship, lorenz-attractor; these match the directory names under src/sims/ which are the route slugs. src/app/simView.ts:254-272 renders each formula via katex.render into div.sim-view__formula-line elements, producing `.katex` DOM. Formula content has been cross-checked against the kernels: Gray-Scott (src/sims/gray-scott/kernel.ts:143-203 uses Du, Dv, F, k with the reaction term UV^2 and feed/kill terms matching the printed PDE); Lorenz (src/sims/lorenz-attractor/kernel.ts:207-209 implements `sigma*(y-x)`, `x*(rho-z)-y`, `x*y-beta*z`, identical to the rendered ODEs); Julia (src/sims/julia-set/kernel.ts:182-183 reads `cRe`/`cIm`, matching the labelled c=cRe+i·cIm); Burning Ship (src/sims/burning-ship/kernel.ts:219-225 takes absolute values of real and imag parts before squaring, matching the rendered formula); Mandelbrot is the canonical z_{n+1}=z_n^2+c with escape |z|>2.
